about_the_game:
Get ready to fight on a brand-new battlefield with Eiche, a fresh map available for free as part of Reinforcement Pack #10.

Inspired by the outskirts of Hamburg, Eiche blends realism and tactical depth in true Eugen fashion. Spanning 81 km² (9x9 km), the map features a dense mix of urban areas, industrial zones, and farmland. Designed for intense 3v3 engagements, Eiche offers a full range of tactical options: chokepoints, thick forests, and built-up areas perfect for well-executed ambushes.

Several key plateaus dominate the center of the battlefield—hold them if you want a chance at victory. Along the flanks, various command zones offer the perfect incentive for bold breakthroughs and flanking maneuvers.

Eiche is playable in both Conquest and Destruction modes and has also been fully integrated into WARNO - SOUTHAG, appearing in both skirmish battles and Army General campaigns.

Reinforcement Pack #10 is available for free to all WARNO owners.
